visualize_rays_plotly_basic: visualize rays using plotly and return an interactive 3D figure with ray lines and points
visualize_rays_plotly_save_html: visualize rays using plotly and save the interactive figure as an HTML file to disk
visualize_rays_plotly_with_colors: visualize rays with RGB pixel colors applied to near-origin points for color-coded ray visualization
visualize_rays_plotly_limit_rays: visualize rays with a maximum number of rays displayed per feature grid subplot
visualize_rays_plotly_custom_layout: visualize rays in a custom grid layout with configurable line width and marker size
